primitives.name: Kinetic Ball Movement
primitives.verbatim_quote: In the Association game the players cannot run with the ball in their hands or arms, but move it rapidly along the ground with their feet—"dribble the ball," as their expression has it.
primitives.assumptions: Ball motion constrained to ground plane; friction dominates over air resistance.

layer2.mapping: GSE trajectory planning for dribbling; GSI models foot-ball interaction using contact mechanics.
layer2.telemetry: Dribble velocity profile and foot-ground contact duration
